summary: Look up replica record diagnostics by primary key instead of loading the complete record list.

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: Uses the existing replica_records record_ref primary key; no migration, index or backfill.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, admission, signing or authority rule change.

compatibility.detail: Existing point and collection response fields and missing-record behavior are preserved. A corrupt unrelated row no longer prevents looking up a different record; selected-row decode errors still propagate. The route leaves the known-growth exceptions and is checked by the default fixed-work cost rule.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond an ordinary binary restart.

manual.detail: No configuration or manual upgrade action required.

recovery.detail: No persisted state changes or recovery procedure.
